about: One entry per merged process-fix PR that names the error rows it fixes (#2058). Add your PR's entry in the same PR. stage: extract (the only step a re-run reaches for now: Knox reads stored texts again only when its rules version moves; read, verify and publish fixes are follow-ups on #2058; a wrong document re-runs through Magellan's link search, #2055). merged_on: the day the PR merges (ISO date); only errors recorded before that day (UTC) are named. The fix must change what Knox extracts: a named fee still live is judged as it stands, so a PR that only changes a check would close rows without a re-extraction. knox_version: the KNOX_RULES_STRATEGY.version the PR bumps to (never above the shipped version). Name the rows by pipeline_feedback check_name (checks), kind (kinds) or id (feedback_ids); at least one. Only rows raised by a check the daily re-check re-runs are named (ERROR_FIX_CHECKS in error-fixes.ts: hamilton.source_check, hamilton.category_guard, deming.not_a_fee_line, deming.name_quality). After merge, Atlas re-runs each named row's institution through the direct path, and Deming's daily error-fix re-check closes the rows whose fee, or the fee the re-run extracted in its place, now matches the bank's document and reports the rest.
